capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists the MY25-26 Grand Touring at 117.0 kWh usable (search excerpt; page rate-limited) and Lucid 2025 sheet gives 117 as capacity (bare); 2026 assumed unchanged.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 2025 hardware assumed unchanged for 2026 (Lucid battery data lists the same 22-module Extended pack for MY26+). Lucid 2025 GT sheet: 900V+.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2025 hardware assumed unchanged for 2026 (Lucid battery data lists the same 22-module Extended pack for MY26+). Lucid 2025 Grand Touring sheet: battery capacity 117 kWh (22 module) (via search excerpt). Other sources 114 (KBB) or 118.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2025 hardware assumed unchanged for 2026 (Lucid battery data lists the same 22-module Extended pack for MY26+). Lucid 2025 GT sheet: up to 300 kW (Lucid charging guide says up to 350 kW on a charger).
